document.name: Architecture
document.purpose: Direct x64 PE image with independent, documented, hash-checked maintenance modules.

design.runtime: Handwritten x64 instruction bytes plus Windows system DLL imports; no compiler, assembler, downloaded static library or language runtime.
design.metadata: Read-only .llm section with a 512-byte header, 128 fixed 192-byte directory entries and individually reserved UTF-8 JSON document slots.
design.entrypoints: Existing function entry RVAs stay stable. An oversized replacement can use a five-byte relative jump gate to a reserved .mods implementation slot.
design.data: Legacy globals retain their exact RVAs and are grouped into explicit versioned memory contracts. New context-based APIs should pass a context pointer rather than add hidden globals.
design.changes: A normal patch changes only its code slot, document slot, directory entry and corresponding unwind entries. A relocation also changes its jump gate, allocator record and exception-directory length.
design.integrity: Per-module SHA-256 for used code and JSON; ABI digest for declared public contract. Hashes detect stale/corrupt patches, not malicious executable semantics.

workflow: Inspect one function and its memory contracts.
Export a patch template containing expected code/document hashes.
Supply explicit instruction bytes and relative-reference fields.
Create a separate candidate; reject stale hashes and public ABI changes.
Verify structural integrity, run native tests, inspect byte-diff boundaries, then promote candidate.
limits: The verifier validates layout, addresses, hashes, padding and supported unwind profiles; it cannot prove raw instructions satisfy their prose contract.
A data-layout or import change is a layout migration, not a routine function patch.
Live hot patching and running-process memory writes are not supported.

document.name: Symbols
document.purpose: Stable image symbol registry for raw-byte fixups. Function names identify stable public entries; local labels use function-relative offsets during relocation.

document.ownership: Single game thread; no concurrent writes.
document.timing: GetTickCount64 monotonic milliseconds; wall-clock survival, movement cadence 75 ms, at most four catch-up fall steps.
transitions: Reset initializes coordinates/board/time but leaves best unchanged.
Finish enters state 2 and persists only a larger best.

document.name: Data.Board
document.purpose: Falling-star grid.
document.mapping: Interior console coordinates: x+7,y+4; player character @.

document.name: Data.Frame
document.purpose: ASCII CHAR_INFO framebuffer and immutable template.
invariants: Strings passed to Text fit remaining row/frame.
FormatTime writes seven digits to an eight-cell field and preserves its decimal separator.

document.name: Data.ScoreRecord
document.purpose: On-disk and in-memory high-score record.
invariants: Read accepts exactly 16 bytes with valid signature, check and range.
Missing or rejected records produce best=0.
Save repairs the signature before writing; a rejected load cannot poison later saves.
document.fixtures: Unit and console tests use separate temporary names and remove them; normal score is untouched.
